structured.answer: If it stays in the עו"ש it slowly loses value: the page says 10,000 ₪ left there 10 years is worth only 8,203 ₪ in today's money, because most banks pay 0%. I won't move anything today; I'll ask my son and the bank clerk, since the other option is some "קרן כספית", and the page also says deposits in Israel aren't insured, which scared me.

stuck.why: The sentence above said '1,797 ₪ פחות', so I didn't know which number was my loss until screen 3 explained it was the gap from the yellow 'קרן כספית' line

stuck.where: Screen 3–4, 'מה קורה לכסף לאורך הזמן' with 62,681 ₪

I wanted to type my own amount, but the page only showed 10,000

findings.what: 'אין ביטוח פיקדונות' appears with no reassurance, so someone like me now fears the bank itself
findings.where: Screen 4 and screen 6 'סיכונים ומה לא מוגן'

findings.what: Two different 'loss' numbers (1,797 and 2,576) close together, and the second only makes sense after the next screen
A second example with 500 ₪ monthly and the huge 62,681 ₪ number confuses things for someone with savings sitting still
Cost section gives no actual fee amount
The only alternative offered is a 'קרן כספית', never explained in plain words, and to me 'קרן' sounds like the fund that fell
English codes like BANK-17 and TXI OQ11 scattered in the text
Dark background, and grey small text such as 'הציר האנכי לא מתחיל באפס' and the legend is hard to read
A red alarming box about a tax exemption I don't understand
A slider for years; luckily there is also a box
